title: Merchandising Glossary — steward-approved terms
count: 12 terms of ≈340 in the merch glossary

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: Collibra business glossary · merchandising data-steward council

rows: Stock Keeping Unit — the sellable item/variant grain of the item master; ≈1.2M active, each carrying ≈400 attributes
Universal Product Code (GS1 GTIN-12) — scan-level barcode; an item may carry multiple UPCs (vendor packs, case packs)
Shelf-level diagram dictating facing, position, and fixture for every SKU in a category; ≈85K live POGs across store clusters
The scheduled sequence of permanent price cuts (typically 25% → 50% → 75% → salvage) to clear seasonal inventory by exit date
Co-op, MDF, and rebate money from suppliers (≈$1.8B/yr) — where realized margin actually hides; governed by ASC 705-20
Minimum Advertised Price — vendor-mandated advertising floor; violations risk loss of vendor funding and supply
Retail set per price zone, not per store — ≈140 zones cover 2,300 stores, balancing competition and margin
Scheduled re-curation of a category's SKU list and shelf set, usually tied to a POG revision; ≈2,400 resets/yr
Aisle-end fixture — the highest-velocity promotional real estate in the store, sold to vendors via funded programs
Audited % of stores whose shelves match the published planogram; drives vendor funding payouts and reset labor planning
Inventory loss from theft, damage, and admin error — measured at physical inventory; a direct margin offset
Units sold ÷ units received over a window; the governing metric for markdown timing and assortment exits
